name: ROCm Examples README
notes: AMD's own ROCm example suite. Structure is the useful part: HIP-Basic (no extra dependencies), HIP-Doc (the code shown in the HIP documentation), Libraries, Applications, Systems (hipFile GPU-direct storage I/O), AI, and Tutorials (code for the HIP tutorials). Prerequisites stated per platform: Linux needs CMake >= 3.21 and ROCm >= 7.x.x; Windows needs Visual Studio 2019 or 2022 with the 'Desktop Development with C++' workload plus the HIP SDK for Windows and the Visual Studio ROCm extension, and notes Perl is required 'for hipify related scripts' - a concrete confirmation that hipify scripts are part of the standard Windows ROCm workflow.
